scientific_scope.auxiliary_comparison: mlp_lat7 vs linear on identical rows

protocol.split: frozen global original_ID held-out test; no refit or selection on test
protocol.continuity: within each source trajectory segment, split wherever adjacent retained timestamps differ from exactly 3600 s
protocol.windows: non-overlapping windows anchored at each continuous episode start; incomplete tail discarded
protocol.displacement_proxy: Euclidean norm of sum((predicted residual - observed residual) * 3600 seconds) / 1000, in km
protocol.background_current: cancels because every model and observation shares the same CFSv2 background current
protocol.primary_aggregation: median endpoint error within original_ID, then equal-ID mean across IDs
protocol.tail_aggregation: P90 endpoint error within original_ID, then equal-ID mean across IDs
